**Daily Devotional**

**April 8**

*13 In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise, 14 Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory. (Ephesians 1:13-14 KJV)*

The Gospel means Good News, and news is something that has already happened. Jesus paid all our debt (Romans 3:24), and that is the Good News. Two things have to happen to be saved, you have to hear the Gospel (Romans 10:14), and you must believe and trust in the message of the Gospel (believe in Jesus) (Acts 16:31; Romans 10:9-10). If you do these two things then you get born again, with a brand new spirit that is then sealed so that it cannot ever sin (1 John 3:9). You, as a born again Christian can still sin, but only in the flesh and soul, as your spirit stays holy and righteous forever.

We Christians are made up of three parts, body, soul and spirit. When we are born again, only the spirit is new with the very spirit of Jesus Christ coming into our body (Galatians 4:6). That is the earnest we have and the guarantee that we will get our new bodies when Jesus comes again (the purchased possession), as we will be like Him (1 John 3:2). Our redemption will then be complete and will be for eternity. Praise God for our redemption and the guarantee of eternal life with the Lord, as long as we don’t disobey Jesus (Hebrews 5:9), or become reprobate (Romans 1:28), or blasphemy the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32). Thank you Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
